lead.event: IDX extends Wijaya Karya’s trading suspension over delayed bond and sukuk payments
lead.headline: IDX extends WIKA trading suspension over six delayed bond and sukuk payments
lead.blurb: Wijaya Karya shares will remain suspended across all markets until further notice after the company postponed six payments due 18 November. They comprise interest on three bond series and profit-sharing payments on three sukuk series. The IDX said the delays indicate problems with the company's business continuity.

earnings_guidance.event: Large-cap coal issuers report mixed nine-month 2026 results
earnings_guidance.headline: Coal issuers report mixed nine-month 2026 results as PTBA profit rises 216.39%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bukit Asam posted the largest profit increase, with net profit up 216.39% to Rp4.41 trillion and revenue up 12.36% to Rp35.20 trillion. Petrindo Jaya Kreasi swung to a US$22.39 million loss despite revenue growth of 39.43%. Bumi Resources' Q3 report remained under limited review and was targeted for release by 30 November.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset recommends accumulation of Indonesian big-bank stocks after the rate hike
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset recommends big-bank stocks after BI raises rate to 6%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Senior analyst Nafan Aji Gusta recommended accumulative buys, saying rupiah stability, controlled NPLs and credit growth within BI and OJK’s 10%-12% YoY target range could restore positive sentiment. His target prices are Rp4,230 for BBNI, Rp5,375 for BMRI, Rp6,775 for BBCA and Rp3,360 for BBRI.

earnings_guidance.event: Petrindo Jaya Kreasi targets first metallurgical coal sales by year-end 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: CUAN targets first metallurgical coal sales by end-2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Petrindo is completing infrastructure for its Daya Bumindo Karunia (DBK) mine, including hauling roads, stockpiles and logistics and port facilities. DBK is expected to contribute to revenue from late 2026, with profit contribution building as production and sales volumes rise.

earnings_guidance.event: Kiwoom Sekuritas revises its AKR Corporindo price target and profit forecast
earnings_guidance.headline: Kiwoom revises AKRA target, forecasts 30.3% net profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: AKR Corporindo is forecast to earn Rp3.1 trillion in 2026 net profit, up from Rp2.41 trillion in 2025, on revenue of Rp60.9 trillion, up 32.4%, and EPS of Rp156 versus Rp120. Nine-month 2026 net profit rose 34% year on year to Rp2.21 trillion, reaching 70.4% of Kiwoom’s full-year forecast.

deals_control.event: Harum Energy shares trade in a Rp4.46 trillion negotiated-market transaction
deals_control.headline: HRUM shares trade in Rp4.46 trillion negotiated-market deal
deals_control.blurb: RTI data show 67.59 million lots changed hands at Rp660 per share in one transaction, with no official explanation released. Harum Energy ended its buyback on 17 November, citing rules related to a planned restructuring by controlling shareholders, and said it could resume later under applicable regulations.

deals_control.event: WIFI records a Rp4.06 trillion negotiated-market block trade
deals_control.headline: WIFI records Rp4.06 trillion negotiated-market block trade
deals_control.blurb: The trade involved 14.16 million lots at Rp2,870 per share, well above the regular-market price. Solusi Sinergi Digital’s regular-market shares rose 7.24% to Rp815, and no official explanation for the block trade had been released.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI demotes Bumi Resources Minerals from its Global Standard index
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI demotes BRMS to Small Cap index from 1 December
market_structure_policy.blurb: Bumi Resources Minerals shifts from Global Standard to Small Cap in MSCI’s November review, effective 1 December. Shares touched a one-year low of Rp282, while Q3 revenue rose 172.8% quarter-on-quarter to US$71.8 million and net profit was US$11 million.
